rules.statement: An express prohibition against alienation is not necessary to create a fidei commissum.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is well-settled law that an express prohibition against alienation is not necessary to create a fidei commissum. To take a simple example. A grant of land to A, subject to the 'condition that upon his death it shall devolve upon B and C, creates a valid fidei commissum in favour of B and C, although there is no express prohibition."
